facts.recommendationText: Implement complaint tracking and customer outreach Capture complaint data to identify patterns and immediately contact affected customers Shows customers concerns are taken seriously; generates data for root cause analysis Immediate action to rebuild trust and prevent repeat customer loss Record what went wrong, customer name, order details, resolution offered Template reviewed and approved by team All complaints receive same-day acknowledgment and manager review Complaints reviewed daily, customers contacted within 24 hours Group complaints by cause, identify most common issue, propose countermeasure Monthly pattern report generated, top 3 issues identified
